text:
alex_sales: Kicking off StratusData POC thread. They want hosted API keys to demo within 48h, plus pricing for Dedicated pool and a VPC route if approved. POC window: 21 days. Request: billing project with a $7,000 target spend cap and $2,000 trial credits. Who can confirm feasibility?

trina_se: Hosted keys + credits = yes. Dedicated + VPC will need capacity intake and a security questionnaire. For billing project I need a billing contact email and whether they want invoices sent to their finance team.

marco_eng: Dedicated lead times vary by region and model family. Typical 2-4 weeks if GPUs available. For an immediate demo we can bump hosted quotas and provide ephemeral keys, but note no SLA.

paul_finance: Clarifying "spend cap": currently we provide token/usage quotas and alerts; we don't have an automatic hard kill for hosted. Ops can manually disable project keys for a hard stop. We can apply $2k promo credit to the new billing project. For invoices/PO, send billing contact + PO number if they want invoicing.

alex_sales: Stratus prefers ephemeral keys with 12h TTL and a CI key for embeddings only. Can we do that? Also prefer region: us-east1.

trina_se: Yes, 12h TTL supported. I'll prepare a small example and rotation notes.

marco_eng: Example internal command for ephemeral key minting:
```
redwoodctl keys create --project stratus-poc --ttl 12h --scopes generation,embeddings --rate 80r/s
```
Returns one-time token. Recommend CI key as long-lived embedding-only key.

paul_finance: I'll create the billing project record once you DM me billing contact. Note: token quota approximate to $7k applied for 21 days. Alerts to both Stratus and our CS.

sec_team: For VPC/private, we need the customer CIDR ranges, allowed egress IPs, an ops contact for firewall coordination, and a signed DPA. If they request on-prem package, SOC2 evidence required. Security intake typically 2-7 business days after docs provided.

ops_oncall: If you need an absolute stop, ops can disable project keys manually. We can also automate a kill runbook triggered by a ticket, but it needs an owner and approval.

trina_se: Proposed minimal path to get them running in 48h:
- create billing project `stratus-poc` and apply $2k credit
- mint ephemeral 12h keys + CI key guidance
- set token quota to approximate $7k for 21 days
- wire alerts to eng@stratusdata.com and cs@redwood.com
- open capacity request for us-east1 Dedicated + security intake for VPC in parallel

alex_sales: I'll DM billing contact now (billing@stratusdata.com). Please include a short onboarding blurb that explains soft cap behavior so they aren't surprised.

paul_finance: Draft onboarding note: "This POC project has a token quota to help control spend and $2,000 in trial credits applied. Quota-triggered alerts will be sent to your engineering contact and Redwood CS. If you require a hard stop, contact support@redwood.com and ops will disable project keys."

deploy-bot: Job queued: create-billing-project/stratus-poc requested by paul_finance ETA 2m.

paul_finance: Billing project created: stratus-poc. Project ID: rwd-st-01001. Applied $2k credit. Please confirm key minting and quota.

trina_se: Minted ephemeral key (masked): sk_demo_****lmno TTL 12h. Token quota set to $7k equivalent for 21-day window. Alerts configured to eng@stratusdata.com and cs@redwood.com.

marco_eng: Opened capacity request REQ-5012 for us-east1 Dedicated pool (models: vicuna-13b quantized). ETA estimate 10-20 business days.

sec_team: Security intake created (SEC-1205). Sent questionnaire link to alex_sales.

ops_oncall: If you want automated kill-runbook, open a task in #eng-oncall with project id and owner. We can script it within 48h after owner assigned.

alex_sales: Sent billing PO and DPA sign request to Stratus legal. Thanks team 44d. I'll update when DPA accepted.

trina_se: Marking this POC setup workflow complete from sales side. Reopen if anything changes."
